verdict.rationale: Attio has the building blocks for a self-serve setup. The individual plan is pitched for exploring Attio "on their own" and includes real-time contact syncing and automatic enrichment, which could quickly fill the workspace with real data. An admin can also switch on the Deal object, and lists plus kanban views can model a pipeline. However, the only migration evidence is a marketing chat snippet in which Attio says it will "map it during onboarding" with a migration checklist, which points to vendor-assisted migration rather than a founder doing it alone. Nothing documents an import flow or a time-to-value under an hour. Missing for 10: documented self-serve import or migration from spreadsheets or other CRMs, any evidence of time-to-working-pipeline (under an hour), a guided onboarding or pipeline template flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of unassisted setup.
